2.translation: and when the stars fall, scattered,

3.translation: and when the seas burst forth,

4.translation: and when the graves are overturned,

5.translation: then each soul will come to know what it has done or what it has left undone.

6.translation: O mankind, what has lured you away from your Lord, the Most Generous,

7.translation: Who created you, then shaped and proportioned you,

8.translation: and assembled you in whatever form He willed?

9.translation: No indeed; but you deny the Judgment Day,

10.translation: while there are watchers[1] over you,
10.footnotes: [1] i.e., angels who preserve all your deeds.

13.translation: Indeed, the righteous will be in Bliss,

14.translation: and the wicked will be in Blazing Fire,

15.translation: which they will enter on Judgment Day,

16.translation: and will never come out of it.

17.translation: How do you know what Judgment Day is?

18.translation: Again, how do you know what Judgment Day is?

19.translation: It is the Day when no soul will be of any help to another, and all command on that Day will be with Allah.
